id-20260828-news-2.title: Purbaya Ensures Pertalite Restrictions for Well-off Groups Will Apply in Late 2026

segments.src: ## Pembatasan Pertalite Mulai Diberlakukan Akhir Tahun
segments.tr: ## Pertalite Restrictions to Begin at the End of the Year

segments.src: Menteri Keuangan Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa menegaskan bahwa pemerintah akan memberlakukan pembatasan pembelian bahan bakar minyak (BBM) bersubsidi jenis Pertalite bagi kelompok masyarakat mampu mulai akhir tahun 2026.
segments.tr: Minister of Finance Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa emphasized that the government will enforce restrictions on the purchase of subsidized fuel oil (BBM) of the Pertalite type for affluent groups of society starting at the end of 2026.

segments.src: Kebijakan ini menyasar kelompok pengeluaran desil 9 dan 10, yakni kelompok rumah tangga dengan tingkat pengeluaran tertinggi menurut data Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS), serta pemilik kendaraan roda empat dengan kriteria tertentu.
segments.tr: This policy targets the 9th and 10th decile expenditure groups, namely household groups with the highest expenditure levels according to Central Bureau of Statistics (BPS) data, as well as four-wheeled vehicle owners with certain criteria.

segments.src: Menurut Purbaya, langkah ini merupakan bagian dari upaya pemerintah untuk memastikan subsidi energi lebih tepat sasaran, yakni benar-benar dinikmati oleh masyarakat yang membutuhkan, bukan kelompok yang secara ekonomi sudah mampu membeli BBM nonsubsidi.
segments.tr: According to Purbaya, this step is part of the government's effort to ensure that energy subsidies are more targeted, meaning they are truly enjoyed by the people in need, rather than groups that are economically capable of buying non-subsidized fuel.

segments.src: ## Alasan di Balik Kebijakan
segments.tr: ## Reasons Behind the Policy

segments.src: Dalam keterangannya, Purbaya menyampaikan bahwa penataan ulang skema subsidi BBM ini juga tidak lepas dari kondisi penerimaan negara yang menurutnya menunjukkan tren positif.
segments.tr: In his statement, Purbaya conveyed that the restructuring of this fuel subsidy scheme is also inseparable from the state revenue condition which he says shows a positive trend.

segments.src: Ia menyebut penerimaan pajak per Agustus 2026 tumbuh sekitar 30 persen dibandingkan periode yang sama tahun sebelumnya, meski klaim tersebut masih perlu dikonfirmasi lebih lanjut melalui data resmi yang akan dipublikasikan oleh Kementerian Keuangan.
segments.tr: He mentioned that tax revenues as of August 2026 grew by about 30 percent compared to the same period the previous year, although this claim still needs further confirmation through official data to be published by the Ministry of Finance.

segments.src: Purbaya menekankan bahwa kenaikan penerimaan negara tidak serta-merta menjadi alasan untuk memperlebar subsidi secara merata, melainkan justru menjadi momentum untuk memperbaiki tata kelola subsidi agar lebih efisien dan berkeadilan.
segments.tr: Purbaya emphasized that the increase in state revenue does not necessarily become a reason to broaden subsidies evenly, but rather becomes momentum to improve subsidy governance to be more efficient and equitable.

segments.src: ## Mekanisme Pembatasan yang Direncanakan
segments.tr: ## Planned Restriction Mechanism

segments.src: Meski belum merinci secara teknis seluruh mekanisme pelaksanaannya, pemerintah disebut tengah menyiapkan sistem verifikasi data agar pembatasan dapat berjalan dengan basis data yang akurat.
segments.tr: Although he has not detailed all technical implementation mechanisms, the government is reportedly preparing a data verification system so that restrictions can run on an accurate database.

segments.src: Beberapa opsi yang selama ini didiskusikan publik antara lain integrasi data kependudukan, data kendaraan, serta profil pengeluaran rumah tangga untuk menentukan kelayakan pembelian Pertalite bersubsidi.
segments.tr: Several options that have been discussed by the public include the integration of population data, vehicle data, and household expenditure profiles to determine eligibility for purchasing subsidized Pertalite.

segments.src: Pemerintah menyatakan akan terus mengevaluasi kesiapan infrastruktur dan sosialisasi kepada masyarakat sebelum kebijakan resmi diterapkan pada akhir 2026, agar transisi berjalan lancar tanpa menimbulkan gejolak di lapangan.
segments.tr: The government stated it will continue to evaluate infrastructure readiness and socialization to the public before the official policy is implemented at the end of 2026, so that the transition runs smoothly without causing upheaval in the field.

segments.src: ## Respons dan Tantangan Implementasi
segments.tr: ## Responses and Implementation Challenges

segments.src: Rencana pembatasan Pertalite bukan wacana baru.
segments.tr: The Pertalite restriction plan is not a new discourse.

segments.src: Pemerintah sebelumnya juga pernah mewacanakan pembatasan serupa, namun implementasinya kerap tertunda karena berbagai pertimbangan teknis dan sosial, termasuk kekhawatiran soal potensi antrean di SPBU serta kesiapan sistem digital untuk memverifikasi kelayakan pembeli.
segments.tr: The government had previously floated a similar restriction, but its implementation was often delayed due to various technical and social considerations, including concerns about potential queues at gas stations (SPBU) and the readiness of digital systems to verify buyer eligibility.

segments.src: Sejumlah kalangan menilai kebijakan ini penting untuk menjaga keberlanjutan fiskal negara, mengingat besarnya beban subsidi energi dalam Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Negara (APBN) setiap tahunnya.
segments.tr: A number of circles consider this policy important to maintain the country's fiscal sustainability, given the heavy burden of energy subsidies in the State Budget (APBN) every year.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, ada pula pihak yang mengingatkan pentingnya sosialisasi yang matang agar masyarakat memahami kriteria yang digunakan dan tidak menimbulkan kebingungan saat kebijakan mulai diterapkan.
segments.tr: On the other hand, there are also parties who remind us of the importance of mature socialization so that the public understands the criteria used and does not cause confusion when the policy begins to be implemented.

segments.src: ## Yang Perlu Diperhatikan ke Depan
segments.tr: ## What to Watch Out for Going Forward

segments.src: Publik kini menanti detail teknis lebih lanjut dari Kementerian Keuangan maupun Kementerian Energi dan Sumber Daya Mineral (ESDM) terkait kriteria pasti kendaraan yang akan dibatasi, mekanisme verifikasi desil pengeluaran, serta jadwal sosialisasi menjelang penerapan aturan pada akhir 2026.
segments.tr: The public is now awaiting further technical details from the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM) regarding the exact criteria for vehicles that will be restricted, the expenditure decile verification mechanism, and the socialization schedule leading up to the implementation of the rules at the end of 2026.

segments.src: Kebijakan ini menjadi salah satu langkah reformasi subsidi energi yang akan terus dipantau perkembangannya, mengingat dampaknya yang cukup luas terhadap masyarakat maupun stabilitas anggaran negara ke depan.
segments.tr: This policy is one of the energy subsidy reform steps that will continue to be monitored for its development, given its quite broad impact on society and future state budget stability.

id-20260828-intro-agriculture-9.title: [Agronomy #9] Why Vegetables, Fruits, and Flowers Are Studied Separately? Understanding the World of Horticulture

segments.src: > Hortikultura adalah cabang ilmu tanaman yang fokus pada sayuran, buah-buahan, dan tanaman hias — komoditas bernilai tinggi yang biasa kita temui di pasar dan pekarangan rumah.
segments.tr: > Horticulture is a branch of plant science that focuses on vegetables, fruits, and ornamental plants — high-value commodities commonly found in markets and home yards.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Kalau kamu pernah dengar kata "pertanian", mungkin yang terbayang adalah sawah padi yang luas.
segments.tr: If you've ever heard the word "agriculture," you might picture vast rice fields.

segments.src: Tapi coba lihat isi kulkas atau meja makanmu: ada tomat, cabai, jeruk, dan mungkin sepot bunga di ruang tamu.
segments.tr: But try looking inside your fridge or at your dining table: there are tomatoes, chilies, oranges, and maybe a potted flower in the living room.

segments.src: Semua itu bukan padi atau jagung — mereka masuk ke dunia bernama **hortikultura**.
segments.tr: All of those are not rice or corn — they enter a world called **horticulture**.

segments.src: Kata "hortikultura" berasal dari bahasa Latin *hortus* (kebun) dan *cultura* (budi daya).
segments.tr: The word "horticulture" comes from the Latin words *hortus* (garden) and *cultura* (cultivation).

segments.src: Jadi secara harfiah artinya "budi daya kebun".
segments.tr: So literally it means "garden cultivation."

segments.src: Bedanya dengan tanaman pangan pokok (seperti padi dan jagung yang ditanam di lahan sangat luas) adalah: tanaman hortikultura umumnya digarap lebih intensif, di lahan lebih kecil, dan bernilai ekonomi tinggi per satuan luas.
segments.tr: The difference from staple food crops (such as rice and corn grown on very large lands) is that horticultural crops are generally managed more intensively, on smaller lands, and have high economic value per unit area.

segments.src: Secara umum, hortikultura dibagi menjadi tiga kelompok besar:
segments.tr: In general, horticulture is divided into three major groups:

segments.src: - **Hortikultura sayuran (olerikultura)** — tanaman yang biasanya berumur pendek (semusim) dan dipanen bagian tertentu untuk dimakan: daun (bayam, sawi), buah muda (cabai, tomat, timun), umbi (wortel, kentang), atau bunga (kembang kol). Umumnya dipanen dalam hitungan minggu sampai beberapa bulan.
segments.tr: - **Vegetable horticulture (olericulture)** — plants that are usually short-lived (annuals) and harvested for specific parts to eat: leaves (spinach, mustard greens), young fruits (chili, tomato, cucumber), tubers (carrot, potato), or flowers (cauliflower). Generally harvested in a matter of weeks to several months.

segments.src: - **Hortikultura buah (pomologi/frutikultura)** — tanaman penghasil buah, sering berupa tanaman tahunan berkayu seperti mangga, durian, jeruk, dan rambutan. Perlu waktu bertahun-tahun sebelum berbuah, tapi bisa dipanen berkali-kali selama bertahun-tahun.
segments.tr: - **Fruit horticulture (pomology/fruticulture)** — fruit-producing plants, often in the form of woody perennials like mango, durian, orange, and rambutan. They take years before bearing fruit, but can be harvested repeatedly for many years.

segments.src: - **Hortikultura hias (florikultura)** — tanaman yang dinikmati keindahannya, bukan untuk dimakan: bunga potong (mawar, krisan), tanaman pot (aglonema, anggrek), dan tanaman lanskap taman.
segments.tr: - **Ornamental horticulture (floriculture)** — plants enjoyed for their beauty, not for eating: cut flowers (roses, chrysanthemums), potted plants (aglaonema, orchids), and garden landscape plants.

segments.src: Pembagian ini bukan sekadar label.
segments.tr: This division is not just a label.

segments.src: Setiap kelompok punya cara tanam, kebutuhan air, teknik panen, dan penanganan pascapanen yang berbeda — sehingga ilmunya pun dipelajari secara terpisah.
segments.tr: Each group has different planting methods, water needs, harvesting techniques, and post-harvest handling — so their sciences are also studied separately.

segments.src: ## Di Kehidupan Sehari-hari
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Bayangkan kamu jalan-jalan pagi di Pasar Beringharjo, Yogyakarta, dengan uang Rp50.000 di kantong.
segments.tr: Imagine you are taking a morning stroll at Beringharjo Market in Yogyakarta with Rp50.000 in your pocket.

segments.src: Di los sayuran, kamu beli seikat bayam dan beberapa cabai rawit merah — itu **hasil olerikultura**, ditanam petani di dataran tinggi Dieng dan dipanen muda, jadi harus cepat dimasak sebelum layu.
segments.tr: At the vegetable stall, you buy a bunch of spinach and some red bird's eye chilies — those are **olericulture products**, planted by farmers in the Dieng highlands and harvested young, so they must be cooked quickly before wilting.

segments.src: Bergeser ke los buah, kamu tergoda sekilo mangga harum manis dan salak pondoh — ini **produk pomologi**, berasal dari pohon yang butuh bertahun-tahun tumbuh sebelum akhirnya berbuah tiap musim.
segments.tr: Moving to the fruit stall, you are tempted by a kilo of Harum Manis mangoes and Pondoh salak — these are **pomology products**, originating from trees that take years to grow before finally bearing fruit every season.

segments.src: Di pintu keluar, ada penjual bunga menawarkan sepot anggrek dan seikat mawar untuk hadiah — itu **florikultura**, dijual bukan karena rasanya, tapi karena keindahannya.
segments.tr: At the exit, there is a flower vendor offering a pot of orchids and a bunch of roses as gifts — that is **floriculture**, sold not for its taste, but for its beauty.

segments.src: Tiga jenis barang, tiga cara petani menanam dan merawatnya, tapi semuanya lahir dari satu payung ilmu yang sama: hortikultura.
segments.tr: Three types of goods, three ways farmers plant and care for them, but all born from the same scientific umbrella: horticulture.

segments.src: Dengan Rp50.000 tadi, tanpa sadar kamu sudah "belanja" dari ketiga cabangnya sekaligus.
segments.tr: With that Rp50.000, you unknowingly "shopped" from all three branches at once.

segments.src: ## Rangkuman 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Hortikultura adalah ilmu budi daya "kebun" untuk tanaman bernilai tinggi, berbeda dari tanaman pangan pokok seperti padi.
segments.tr: 1. Horticulture is the science of "garden" cultivation for high-value plants, different from staple food crops like rice.

segments.src: 2. Ia terbagi menjadi tiga: sayuran (olerikultura), buah (pomologi), dan tanaman hias (florikultura).
segments.tr: 2. It is divided into three: vegetables (olericulture), fruits (pomology), and ornamental plants (floriculture).

segments.src: 3. Setiap kelompok punya karakter, umur panen, dan cara penanganan yang berbeda, sehingga dipelajari secara terpisah.
segments.tr: 3. Each group has different characteristics, harvest ages, and handling methods, so they are studied separately.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self Quiz

segments.src: 1. Cabang hortikultura yang mempelajari budi daya tanaman hias seperti mawar dan anggrek disebut...
segments.tr: 1. The branch of horticulture that studies the cultivation of ornamental plants like roses and orchids is called...

segments.src: - A. Olerikultura
segments.tr: - A. Olericulture

segments.src: - B. Pomologi
segments.tr: - B. Pomology

segments.src: - C. Florikultura
segments.tr: - C. Floriculture

segments.src: 2. Mangga dan durian termasuk kelompok hortikultura buah (pomologi).
segments.tr: 2. Mangoes and durians belong to the fruit horticulture group (pomology).

segments.src: - (Benar / Salah)
segments.tr: - (True / False)

segments.src: 3. Padi termasuk komoditas utama hortikultura sama seperti tomat dan cabai.
segments.tr: 3. Rice is a major horticultural commodity just like tomatoes and chilies.

segments.src: - (Benar / Salah)
segments.tr: - (True / False)

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Hortikultura**: ilmu budi daya tanaman kebun bernilai tinggi (sayuran, buah, tanaman hias).
segments.tr: - **Horticulture**: the science of high-value garden plant cultivation (vegetables, fruits, ornamental plants).

segments.src: - **Olerikultura**: cabang hortikultura yang mempelajari budi daya tanaman sayuran.
segments.tr: - **Olericulture**: the branch of horticulture that studies vegetable plant cultivation.

segments.src: - **Pomologi**: cabang hortikultura yang mempelajari budi daya tanaman buah.
segments.tr: - **Pomology**: the branch of horticulture that studies fruit plant cultivation.

segments.src: - **Florikultura**: cabang hortikultura yang mempelajari budi daya tanaman hias dan bunga.
segments.tr: - **Floriculture**: the branch of horticulture that studies the cultivation of ornamental plants and flowers.

segments.src: - **Pascapanen**: penanganan hasil setelah dipanen (penyimpanan, pengemasan, distribusi) agar tetap segar.
segments.tr: - **Post-harvest**: handling of produce after harvest (storage, packaging, distribution) to keep it fresh.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1) C — florikultura khusus tanaman hias.
segments.tr: *Answers: 1) C — floriculture specifically for ornamental plants.

segments.src: 2) Benar — keduanya buah dari pohon tahunan, masuk pomologi.
segments.tr: 2) True — both are fruits from perennial trees, falling under pomology.

segments.src: 3) Salah — padi adalah tanaman pangan pokok, bukan hortikultura; contoh hortikultura adalah tomat dan cabai.*
segments.tr: 3) False — rice is a staple food crop, not horticulture; examples of horticulture are tomatoes and chilies.*

id-20260828-news-1.title: JCI Surges 1.81% to 6,521 on August 27 Protest Day, Rupiah Begins to Stabilize

segments.src: Pergerakan pasar keuangan domestik pada 27 Agustus menghadirkan kejutan bagi banyak pelaku pasar.
segments.tr: The movement of the domestic financial market on August 27 presented a surprise for many market participants.

segments.src: Di tengah berlangsungnya aksi unjuk rasa besar yang sebelumnya dikhawatirkan sejumlah analis dapat memicu tekanan jual, Indeks Harga Saham Gabungan (IHSG) justru ditutup menguat tajam 1,81% ke level 6.521.
segments.tr: Amidst the ongoing large-scale protests that some analysts previously feared could trigger selling pressure, the Jakarta Composite Index (JCI) actually closed sharply higher by 1.81% to the 6,521 level.

segments.src: Penguatan ini berlangsung bersamaan dengan mulai stabilnya nilai tukar rupiah, setelah sempat tertekan ke kisaran Rp17.725 per dolar AS beberapa waktu sebelumnya.
segments.tr: This strengthening occurred concurrently with the stabilization of the rupiah exchange rate, after it had been pressured to the range of Rp17,725 per US dollar some time earlier.

segments.src: ## Kejutan di Tengah Ketidakpastian
segments.tr: ## Surprises Amidst Uncertainty

segments.src: Sebagian besar analis pasar modal sempat memproyeksikan bahwa hari berlangsungnya aksi massa berskala besar akan membuat investor bersikap wait and see, bahkan berpotensi memicu aksi jual (sell-off) akibat kekhawatiran atas stabilitas jangka pendek.
segments.tr: Most capital market analysts had projected that the day of large-scale mass actions would cause investors to adopt a wait-and-see approach, potentially even triggering a sell-off due to concerns over short-term stability.

segments.src: Namun, data perdagangan menunjukkan arah yang berlawanan dari perkiraan tersebut.
segments.tr: However, trading data showed a direction contrary to those predictions.

segments.src: Beberapa faktor yang kerap disebut dalam analisis pasar terkait penguatan indeks di tengah situasi semacam ini antara lain:
segments.tr: Some factors often cited in market analysis regarding the index's strengthening amidst such situations include:

segments.src: - **Aksi beli oportunistik**: sebagian investor domestik maupun institusi kerap memanfaatkan momen ketidakpastian jangka pendek untuk masuk ke saham-saham yang dinilai sudah murah (undervalued).
segments.tr: - **Opportunistic buying**: some domestic and institutional investors often take advantage of short-term uncertainty moments to enter stocks deemed undervalued.

segments.src: - **Sentimen pasar global yang mendukung**: pergerakan bursa regional dan global pada hari yang sama turut memberi tenaga tambahan bagi indeks domestik.
segments.tr: - **Supportive global market sentiment**: regional and global stock market movements on the same day also provided additional momentum for the domestic index.

segments.src: - **Ekspektasi bahwa situasi terkendali**: pasar cenderung merespons positif ketika situasi di lapangan dinilai berjalan tertib dan tidak mengganggu aktivitas ekonomi secara signifikan.
segments.tr: - **Expectations that the situation is under control**: the market tends to respond positively when the situation on the ground is perceived to be orderly and not significantly disrupting economic activity.

segments.src: Penting dicatat bahwa pergerakan indeks dalam satu hari perdagangan bersifat sangat dinamis dan dipengaruhi banyak variabel sekaligus, sehingga penguatan ini tidak dapat ditafsirkan sebagai indikasi tunggal atas satu peristiwa saja.
segments.tr: It is important to note that index movements in a single trading day are highly dynamic and influenced by many variables simultaneously, so this strengthening cannot be interpreted as a sole indication of one event alone.

segments.src: ## Rupiah Mulai Menemukan Titik Keseimbangan
segments.tr: ## Rupiah Begins to Find an Equilibrium Point

segments.src: Selain penguatan di pasar saham, nilai tukar rupiah terhadap dolar AS juga menunjukkan tanda-tanda stabilisasi.
segments.tr: In addition to the strengthening in the stock market, the rupiah exchange rate against the US dollar also showed signs of stabilization.

segments.src: Setelah sempat berada di level tertekan sekitar Rp17.725 per dolar AS, pergerakan mata uang domestik berangsur menemukan titik keseimbangan baru.
segments.tr: After previously being at a pressured level of around Rp17,725 per US dollar, the domestic currency's movement gradually found a new equilibrium point.

segments.src: Stabilisasi ini umumnya dikaitkan dengan intervensi rutin otoritas moneter dalam menjaga volatilitas nilai tukar, serta arus modal yang tetap mengalir ke instrumen domestik.
segments.tr: This stabilization is generally attributed to routine interventions by monetary authorities in maintaining exchange rate volatility, as well as capital flows that continue to enter domestic instruments.

segments.src: Para pelaku pasar biasanya mencermati beberapa indikator lanjutan untuk menilai apakah stabilisasi ini bersifat sementara atau berkelanjutan, seperti arah kebijakan suku bunga, arus dana asing (capital flow), serta perkembangan kondisi sosial-politik dalam beberapa hari ke depan.
segments.tr: Market participants usually monitor several follow-up indicators to assess whether this stabilization is temporary or sustainable, such as the direction of interest rate policies, capital flows, and developments in the socio-political situation in the next few days.

segments.src: ## Bagaimana Investor Ritel Sebaiknya Menyikapi Kondisi Ini
segments.tr: ## How Retail Investors Should Respond to This Condition

segments.src: Fluktuasi pasar dalam periode isu sosial maupun politik memang lazim terjadi dan bisa berlangsung cepat berbalik arah.
segments.tr: Market fluctuations during periods of social or political issues are indeed common and can reverse direction quickly.

segments.src: Beberapa hal yang umum disarankan oleh perencana keuangan dalam menghadapi situasi pasar yang bergerak cepat seperti ini antara lain:
segments.tr: Some things commonly suggested by financial planners in facing fast-moving market situations like this include:

segments.src: 1. Tidak mengambil keputusan investasi besar hanya berdasarkan pergerakan harga dalam satu hari.
segments.tr: 1. Do not make major investment decisions based solely on price movements in a single day.

segments.src: 2. Tetap memperhatikan fundamental emiten dan kondisi makroekonomi secara menyeluruh, bukan sekadar sentimen jangka pendek.
segments.tr: 2. Continue to pay attention to issuer fundamentals and overall macroeconomic conditions, not just short-term sentiment.

segments.src: 3. Menjaga diversifikasi portofolio agar tidak terlalu bergantung pada satu instrumen atau sektor tertentu.
segments.tr: 3. Maintain portfolio diversification so as not to be too dependent on one specific instrument or sector.

segments.src: 4. Mengikuti perkembangan dari sumber informasi resmi seperti Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) dan Bank Indonesia untuk data yang lebih akurat.
segments.tr: 4. Follow developments from official information sources such as the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) and Bank Indonesia for more accurate data.

segments.src: ## Catatan Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing Notes

segments.src: Penguatan IHSG ke 6.521 dan mulai stabilnya rupiah pada 27 Agustus menjadi pengingat bahwa pasar keuangan tidak selalu bergerak searah dengan ekspektasi maupun kekhawatiran publik secara umum.
segments.tr: The JCI's strengthening to 6,521 and the beginning of the rupiah's stabilization on August 27 serve as a reminder that financial markets do not always move in line with public expectations or concerns in general.

segments.src: Situasi sosial-politik tetap perlu dicermati, namun keputusan finansial sebaiknya didasarkan pada data dan analisis yang komprehensif, bukan semata reaksi sesaat terhadap satu peristiwa.
segments.tr: The socio-political situation still needs to be monitored, but financial decisions should be based on comprehensive data and analysis, not merely on momentary reactions to a single event.

segments.src: *Artikel ini bersifat informatif dan bukan merupakan ajakan atau rekomendasi untuk melakukan keputusan investasi tertentu.
segments.tr: *This article is informative and is not an invitation or recommendation to make specific investment decisions.

segments.src: Selalu lakukan riset mandiri atau konsultasikan dengan penasihat keuangan tepercaya sebelum mengambil keputusan finansial.*
segments.tr: Always conduct independent research or consult with a trusted financial advisor before making financial decisions.*

id-20260828-news-3.title: DPR Targets Asset Forfeiture Bill to be Passed by December 15, 2026

segments.src: ## Kesepakatan Tenggat Waktu di Tengah Sorotan Publik
segments.tr: ## Deadline Agreement Amid Public Spotlight

segments.src: Rapat Paripurna Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat (DPR) yang digelar pada 27 Agustus 2026 menghasilkan kesepakatan penting terkait nasib Rancangan Undang-Undang (RUU) Perampasan Aset.
segments.tr: The Plenary Session of the House of Representatives (DPR) held on August 27, 2026, resulted in an important agreement regarding the fate of the Asset Forfeiture Bill (RUU Perampasan Aset).

segments.src: Dalam forum tersebut, DPR menyepakati target waktu pengesahan RUU ini paling lambat pada 15 Desember 2026.
segments.tr: In that forum, the DPR agreed on a target date for the passage of this bill no later than December 15, 2026.

segments.src: Yang menarik perhatian publik, rapat ini berlangsung tepat pada hari yang sama dengan aksi unjuk rasa berskala besar di sejumlah wilayah.
segments.tr: Interestingly for the public, this meeting took place on the exact same day as large-scale demonstrations in several regions.

segments.src: Salah satu tuntutan utama yang disuarakan massa aksi adalah kepastian aturan mengenai perampasan aset hasil tindak pidana, terutama yang berkaitan dengan praktik korupsi.
segments.tr: One of the main demands voiced by the protesters was for certainty in regulations regarding the forfeiture of assets resulting from criminal acts, especially those related to corruption practices.

segments.src: Kesepakatan tenggat waktu ini pun dipandang sebagai respons DPR terhadap desakan tersebut, meski proses legislasinya sendiri merupakan bagian dari agenda yang telah berjalan di parlemen.
segments.tr: This deadline agreement is seen as the DPR's response to that pressure, although the legislative process itself is part of an agenda that has already been underway in parliament.

segments.src: ## Substansi RUU Perampasan Aset
segments.tr: ## Substance of the Asset Forfeiture Bill

segments.src: RUU Perampasan Aset dirancang untuk memberikan landasan hukum yang lebih kuat bagi penegak hukum dalam menyita aset yang diduga berasal dari tindak pidana, termasuk dalam skema yang dikenal sebagai *non-conviction based asset forfeiture* atau perampasan aset tanpa harus menunggu putusan pidana berkekuatan hukum tetap terhadap pelakunya.
segments.tr: The Asset Forfeiture Bill is designed to provide a stronger legal basis for law enforcement to seize assets suspected of originating from criminal acts, including within a scheme known as *non-conviction based asset forfeiture*, or asset forfeiture without having to wait for a final and binding criminal court verdict against the perpetrator.

segments.src: Mekanisme semacam ini banyak diadopsi di berbagai negara sebagai instrumen untuk mempercepat pemulihan kerugian negara, terutama pada kasus-kasus di mana pelaku telah meninggal dunia, melarikan diri, atau tidak dapat diproses secara pidana karena berbagai kendala.
segments.tr: This type of mechanism is widely adopted in various countries as an instrument to accelerate the recovery of state losses, especially in cases where the perpetrator has died, fled, or cannot be prosecuted criminally due to various obstacles.

segments.src: Wacana RUU ini sendiri bukan hal baru, sebab pembahasannya sudah berlangsung selama bertahun-tahun namun kerap tertunda karena kompleksitas materi hukum yang diaturnya.
segments.tr: The discourse on this bill is not new, as its discussion has been ongoing for years but has often been delayed due to the complexity of the legal material it regulates.

segments.src: ## Tantangan dalam Pembahasan
segments.tr: ## Challenges in Deliberation

segments.src: Sejumlah kalangan yang mengikuti perkembangan legislasi ini menilai bahwa target 15 Desember 2026 merupakan tenggat yang cukup ketat mengingat masih ada beberapa poin krusial yang perlu diharmonisasi, di antaranya:
segments.tr: A number of observers following the progress of this legislation assess that the December 15, 2026, target is a fairly tight deadline, considering there are still several crucial points that need to be harmonized, including:

segments.src: - Definisi dan ruang lingkup aset yang dapat dirampas
segments.tr: - Definition and scope of assets that can be forfeited

segments.src: - Mekanisme pembuktian terbalik yang tidak melanggar prinsip praduga tak bersalah
segments.tr: - Reverse burden of proof mechanism that does not violate the principle of presumption of innocence

segments.src: - Perlindungan hak pihak ketiga yang beritikad baik
segments.tr: - Protection of the rights of third parties acting in good faith

segments.src: - Sinkronisasi dengan undang-undang lain yang sudah lebih dulu mengatur soal tindak pidana pencucian uang dan pemberantasan korupsi
segments.tr: - Synchronization with other laws that already regulate money laundering and corruption eradication

segments.src: Badan Legislasi DPR bersama pemerintah dijadwalkan akan melanjutkan pembahasan secara maraton dalam beberapa bulan ke depan agar tenggat waktu tersebut dapat tercapai tanpa mengorbankan kualitas substansi undang-undang.
segments.tr: The DPR's Legislative Body, together with the government, is scheduled to continue marathon discussions over the next few months so that the deadline can be met without sacrificing the quality of the law's substance.

segments.src: ## Respons Publik dan Harapan ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Public Response and Future Hopes

segments.src: Bagi banyak pengamat kebijakan publik, kesepakatan ini dianggap sebagai langkah positif meski implementasinya masih harus dikawal ketat.
segments.tr: For many public policy observers, this agreement is considered a positive step, although its implementation must still be closely monitored.

segments.src: Pengesahan sebuah undang-undang tidak serta-merta menyelesaikan persoalan pemberantasan korupsi, namun kehadiran instrumen hukum yang lebih tegas soal perampasan aset diharapkan dapat memperkuat efek jera sekaligus mempercepat pengembalian kerugian negara ke kas publik.
segments.tr: The passage of a law does not automatically solve the problem of corruption eradication, but the presence of a firmer legal instrument regarding asset forfeiture is expected to strengthen the deterrent effect while accelerating the return of state losses to the public treasury.

segments.src: Masyarakat kini menanti langkah konkret DPR dalam beberapa bulan mendatang, termasuk transparansi proses pembahasan pasal demi pasal, sebelum RUU ini benar-benar disahkan menjadi undang-undang sesuai target yang telah disepakati.
segments.tr: The public is now awaiting concrete steps from the DPR in the coming months, including transparency in the article-by-article discussion process, before this bill is truly passed into law according to the agreed-upon target.
